verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents a legal stance through its U.S. Legal Shield: it covers scraping and parsing of search engine data as long as the customer's use is not illegal, with up to $2M coverage on Production plans and above. A community quote also cites its framing of crawling public search data as protected under the First Amendment. This is a permitted-use and legal-risk position, but it is not a stated policy on robots.txt or on licensing of the scraped content. Missing for 10: an explicit robots.txt stance, a content licensing/copyright policy for returned results, and detailed permitted-use terms beyond 'not illegal'.
